client_alerts.headline: Grok models now inside Microsoft Copilot
client_alerts.body: xAI's Grok has landed as a model option inside Microsoft Copilot alongside OpenAI models. Clients on Microsoft 365 Copilot who restrict approved AI vendors (data residency, training-data policy) should check whether Grok is enabled by default in their tenant and confirm it fits their AI vendor risk register.

top_moves.title: Grok expands into Microsoft Copilot while Grok 4.7 itself keeps slipping
top_moves.body: xAI shipped Grok Bot enterprise connectors (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong) and got Grok models placed inside Microsoft Copilot, even as the headline Grok 4.7 model missed its Sept 12 target again ("needs a few more days").

top_moves.title: Claude Sonnet 5's scheduled price hike didn't happen
top_moves.body: The planned Sept 1 increase to $3/$15 per MTok was cancelled — Sonnet 5's introductory $2/$10 pricing is now the standing price, keeping Claude the cheaper option for long-context runbook and proposal drafting.

top_moves.title: CBTS acquires Recovery Point Systems
top_moves.body: A DRaaS and cyber-resiliency specialist gets absorbed into a larger managed-services player — a data point for the consolidation wave hitting the DR vendor landscape Chris advises clients on.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.headline: GPT-6 Astra reached full GA across ChatGPT and the API, with a new full-duplex voice API (GPT-Live-1) and Images 2.5.
providers.detail: GPT-6 Astra (Sept 3) scores 72.6% on OSWorld 2.0 computer-use benchmarks in ~47% less time than GPT-5.6 Sol. GPT-Live-1 brings full-duplex voice with 12 new voices and native transcripts to the API. ChatGPT Images 2.5 adds sketch-to-image and templates; desktop app gets quick-chat from floating Pets controls.

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.headline: Sonnet 5's scheduled price increase was cancelled and Claude Code shipped a bug-fix release.
providers.detail: The Sept 1 bump to $3/$15 per MTok did not occur — $2/$10 is now standard pricing. Claude Code v2.1.268 fixed HTTP 400 failures on third-party endpoints and a WebFetch hang, plus faster --resume rendering. Enterprise smart reports (usage/cost/friction analytics) entered beta.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.headline: Gemini Live is pushing past chat into task automation with Personal Intelligence, Daily Brief, and Spark.
providers.detail: Google continues turning Gemini into a supervised digital worker able to handle files, screens, and hands-free inbox management. Gemini 3.7 Flash remains the current agentic/coding model; Gemini Enterprise carries pay-as-you-go pricing with token discounts up to 20%.

providers.name: xAI
providers.headline: Grok 4.7 slipped past its Sept 12 target again, even as Grok expands into Microsoft Copilot and gets native iPad/Android apps.
providers.detail: Musk's Sept 2 "10 days" promise and the Sept 12 target have both passed with no ship. Meanwhile Grok Bot launched for enterprise with persistent cloud agents and CRM connectors, and Grok models now appear as an option inside Microsoft Copilot.
providers.alertReason: Grok now available inside Microsoft Copilot tenants

providers.name: Meta
providers.headline: No new headline since Muse Spark 1.3 (Sept 2); the open-weights release remains undated.
providers.detail: Muse Spark 1.3 stays Meta's frontier model, still closed-weights with no HuggingFace release as of Sept 4. No movement on the promised open-weight successor to the abandoned Llama line.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.headline: Quiet since Sept 1 — OCR 4.1 GA and Agentic Search remain the latest ships.
providers.detail: No new release today. Leanstral 1.5 (Lean 4 formal-proof model) is scheduled to retire Sept 30, 2026 — anyone using it for formal verification workflows should plan a migration.

providers.name: Perplexity
providers.headline: No new headline today — Computer in Email, the Teams app, and expanded model access continue rolling out from August.
providers.detail: Computer sessions can now start from email threads and show inline diffs for file edits. Model access now includes GPT-5.6 Terra, Grok 4.6, DeepSeek V4 Pro, Kimi K3, and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning.

providers.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
providers.headline: Copilot Cowork got a substantial rebuild: renamed Automations, a GPT/Claude model picker in the prompt box, and a reasoning-effort slider.
providers.detail: Sharing of individual responses or full chat sessions is now built in, along with model-driven answer cards (weather, finance, news). GPT-6 Astra joined the model roster in Cowork and Copilot Studio starting Sept 4.

providers.name: GitHub Copilot
providers.headline: MAI-Code-1-Flash was deprecated across all Copilot surfaces (Sept 10); CLI v1.0.83 adds Windows taskbar status and custom agents.
providers.detail: The deprecation hit Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask/agent modes, and code completions simultaneously. Copilot Code, Cursor, and Claude Code continue to trade places atop developer-satisfaction surveys.

providers.name: Cursor
providers.headline: No new ship today — Claude Fable 5.1 (added Sept 2) and self-hosted machines remain the latest features.
providers.detail: Nine days quiet. No change to report since the last edition.

providers.name: Gamma
providers.headline: No headline release today — 87 days quiet since June 12.
providers.detail: Gamma's AI editing layer (Gamma Agent, from Gamma 3.0) remains the most recent capability update.

providers.name: Notion AI
providers.headline: Workspace owners can now restrict which AI models Notion Agent and Custom Agents are allowed to use.
providers.detail: Business/Enterprise plans get per-model governance for cost predictability and compliance. Agents can now propose changes instead of applying them directly, letting users approve edits one at a time — useful for client-facing docs.

persistent_signals.text: xAI — Grok 4.7 release delay — 2 weeks running (Sept 2's "10 days" promise and the Sept 12 target have both passed with no ship)
Mistral — quiet since Sept 1 — 2 weeks running (OCR 4.1 GA and Agentic Search remain the only current items)
Perplexity — no new headline, same August rollout items (Computer in Email, Teams app) — 2 weeks running
Cursor — quiet since Claude Fable 5.1 addition — 2 weeks running
Notion — AI model governance rollout — 2nd day running (per-workspace model control shipped Sept 9, still the top Notion story today)

month_themes.then: Open-weight model releases (Meta's Muse Glimmer); billing-model overhauls (Notion Workers→Credits); hard shutdown deadlines forcing migrations (Anthropic Prompt Tools API, Gemini image models).
month_themes.now: Agentic-benchmark model upgrades (GPT-6 Astra GA); pricing stability as a competitive lever (Claude Sonnet 5's cancelled hike, Notion's model-cost governance); DR/BCP vendor consolidation and AI-agent risk (CBTS/Recovery Point deal, Gartner's 40% agent-adoption forecast).

habits.shift: Pricing stayed at the $2/$10 intro rate instead of rising to $3/$15 — no cost pressure to switch away from Claude for long-context runbook drafting.
NIST's draft guide for using AI in CSF 2.0 compliance reporting is open for comment through Oct 15 — worth reading before it locks in language clients will cite.
Computer's inline diff view is useful for comparing DRaaS vendor docs side-by-side post CBTS/Recovery Point consolidation.
Its agentic long-horizon planning suits multi-step SOW drafts that need tool use across several source documents — still review before sending.
With Gamma still quiet (87 days), Copilot's rebuilt Cowork/Notebooks UI and model picker are the more actively-developed option this month.
The new full-duplex voice API (12 voices, native transcripts) could produce narrated walkthroughs faster than current static-voice tooling — worth a pilot.

watch.title: NIST SP 1353 public comment period
watch.body: Comments due Oct 15, 2026 on NIST's draft guide for using AI in CSF 2.0 compliance reporting — relevant to any client using AI-assisted compliance tooling.

watch.title: Grok 4.7 launch keeps slipping
watch.body: Musk's Sept 2 "10 days" claim and the Sept 12 target have both passed; xAI now says it "needs a few more days." Watch for the actual ship date and whether the 2.1T-parameter claim holds.

watch.title: Mistral retires Leanstral 1.5
watch.body: Sept 30, 2026 retirement — migrate any Lean 4 formal-proof workflows before then.

watch.title: Meta's Muse Spark open-weights release
watch.body: Still undated as of Sept 4; would be Meta's first open-weight model since abandoning the Llama line if/when it ships.

watch.title: AI agent sprawl outpacing DR planning
watch.body: Gartner projects 40% of enterprise apps will embed task-specific AI agents by end of 2026, up from under 5% in 2025 — DR/BCP plans built before this shift may not cover agent failure modes.

sources: Sources consulted: OpenAI/Anthropic/Google/xAI/Meta/Mistral/Perplexity/Microsoft/GitHub/Gamma/Notion release notes and changelogs (Releasebot, official blogs, platform docs), plus DRJ, BusinessWire, and NIST/CSA coverage of BCP/DR and AI-compliance developments; Reddit top-post data was not retrievable via search today.
